data.name: Rishav
data.gender_notes: Rishav is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rishav is recorded with the meaning “Lord of the Senses”. Rishav is a Hindu name meaning “Lord of the Senses”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: ऋषव्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rishi (sage) + Van (forest) => Rishav (living in the forest as a sage)

in_hindi.name: ऋषव्
in_hindi.long_meaning: Riśa (Rishi) + Vān (van) => Rishav (living in the forest as a sage)

in_tamil.name: ஋ஷவ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Riśi (Rishi) + Vaṉ (van) => Rishav (living in the forest as a sage)

in_telugu.name: ఋషవ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Riśi (Rishi) + Van (van) => Rishav (living in the forest as a sage)

in_marathi.name: Rishav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Senses
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rishav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who has control over the senses and the mind, a name for a baby boy

in_bengali.name: Rishav
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Senses
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rishav একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who has control over the senses and the mind, a name for a baby boy
